children.name: Polydactylus sextarius
children.description: Polydactylus sextarius, the blackspot threadfin, is a species of marine ray-finned fish, a threadfin from the family Polynemidae which is native to the western Pacific and eastern Indian Oceans.

children.name: Eleutheronema tetradactylum
children.description: Eleutheronema tetradactylum, the fourfinger threadfin, known as rawas in India is a species of marine ray-finned fish, a threadfin from the family Polynemidae which occurs in the Indian and western Pacific Ocean.

children.name: Filistriatus sexfilis
children.description: Filistriatus sexfilis, the six-finger threadfin or yellowthread threadfin, is a species of marine ray-finned fish, a threadfin from the family Polynemidae which is found in the Indian and Pacific Oceans.

children.name: Filistriatus plebeius
children.description: Filistriatus plebeius, the striped threadfin, also known as the common threadfin, Northern threadfin or puttynose, is a species of marine fish native to the Indo-Pacific.

children.name: Polynemus aquilonaris
children.description: Polynemus aquilonaris, commonly known as the northern paradise fish, is a fish of the threadfin family Polynemidae.

children.name: Polynemus multifilis
children.description: Polynemus multifilis, the elegant paradise fish, is a species of ray-finned fish, a threadfin from the family Polynemidae which is found in rivers in southeast Asia.
